title: AMD expects to outsell Intel in Q4 for the first time in history
why_read: A business/market milestone about AMD overtaking Intel in quarterly sales, interesting for industry trend-watchers but not technically deep.
analysis: This reports a forecasted sales milestone where AMD is expected to outsell Intel in a given quarter for the first time, reflecting years of competitive shifts in CPU and GPU markets. It's primarily a business and market-share story rather than a technical deep dive into chip architecture or engineering. Still relevant context for engineers who track hardware ecosystem trends and vendor competition.
